South Korean government and the Korean Professional Football Federation introduced a [[Decentralization policy in K League|decentralization policy]] to proliferate the popularity of football nationally in preparation for the [[2002 FIFA World Cup]], which they wanted to host, so some clubs located in the capital [[Seoul]] (LG Cheetahs, Ilhwa Chunma) moved to other cities according to the
